found.name: Learning Development team
found.quote: The Learning Development team provides guidance on using proof-reading or grammar-checking software without being at risk of academic misconduct.

You may choose to be accompanied by a companion, who should be a member of the College (for example a fellow student, member of staff, someone from the Student Union Advice team or a College-approved mentor).
